description.text: The Giratina deck of Giratina VS Dialga, a Japanese Versus Starter Pack released on 10 July 2008, the same day as the Intense Fight in the Destroyed Sky expansion. Its two ready-built 30-card half decks hold four holo cards between them, and many of their cards differ in artwork and attacks from the expansion versions. Damage counters and markers, a coin and a how-to-play book came with it. This deck runs Giratina with Dusknoir and Shaymin, who got its first card in the expansion released that day.
